bureau: centrales de riesgo privadas (private credit bureaus) and the SIBOIF Central de Riesgo
note: The Superintendencia's norm on private credit bureaus (CD-SIBOIF-577-1-MAR18-2009), article 12: a bureau keeps a user's information five years from when the credit is collected in full. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.
